argus.screen.title: Argus
argus.tab.zoom.tooltip: Zoom levels, scrolling and what shows while zoomed
argus.release.smooth.tooltip: The camera swings back to where you are facing.
argus.release.instant.tooltip: The camera snaps back to where you are facing.
argus.release.stay.tooltip: The camera stays where it is until you press the recenter key.
argus.option.zoomToggle.tooltip: Press the zoom key once to zoom and again to stop, instead of holding it.
argus.option.initialZoom.tooltip: The zoom level you get when you press the zoom key.
argus.option.rememberZoom.tooltip: Start from the level you last used. It is kept when you restart the game.
argus.option.unlimitedZoom.tooltip: Ignore the maximum and let scrolling go up to 100000x.
argus.option.maxZoom.tooltip: How far scrolling can zoom in, up to 1000x.
argus.option.scrollStep.tooltip: Each scroll notch multiplies the zoom by this much.
argus.option.fineStep.tooltip: The step used while the fine zoom key is held.
argus.option.smoothZoom.tooltip: Ease between zoom levels instead of jumping.
argus.option.zoomSpeed.tooltip: How fast the zoom eases to a new level.
argus.option.sensitivityScaling.tooltip: How much the mouse slows down as you zoom in. 100% keeps aiming the same on screen, 0% leaves the mouse alone.
argus.option.cinematic.tooltip: Smooth the mouse while zoomed, like the cinematic camera.
argus.option.middleClickReset.tooltip: Middle click while zoomed to go back to the starting zoom.
argus.option.indicator.tooltip: Show the zoom level under the crosshair while zooming.
argus.option.vignette.tooltip: Darken the screen edges while zoomed.
argus.option.zoomHideHand.tooltip: Hide your hand and held item while zoomed.
argus.option.hideHud.tooltip: Hide the hotbar, chat and the rest of the HUD while zooming.
argus.option.pullEnabled.tooltip: In third person or while freelooking, scrolling out past 1x pulls the camera back from you.
argus.option.pullMax.tooltip: How far the camera can pull back, in blocks.
argus.option.pullStep.tooltip: How far each scroll notch moves the camera.
argus.option.pullSmooth.tooltip: Ease the camera to its new distance.
argus.option.pullSpeed.tooltip: How fast the camera eases to its new distance.
argus.option.widenFov.tooltip: In first person, scrolling out past 1x widens the field of view instead of stopping.
argus.option.widenMaxFov.tooltip: The widest field of view scrolling out can reach.
argus.option.freelookToggle.tooltip: Press the freelook key once to start and again to stop, instead of holding it.
argus.option.autoThirdPerson.tooltip: Go to third person while freelooking and back when it ends.
argus.option.release.tooltip: What the camera does when freelook ends.
argus.option.returnSpeed.tooltip: How fast the camera swings back to where you are facing.
argus.option.invertPitch.tooltip: Flip up and down while freelooking.
argus.option.pitchMax.tooltip: How far down the freelook camera can go.
argus.option.pitchMin.tooltip: How far up the freelook camera can go.
argus.option.freelookHideHand.tooltip: Hide your hand and held item while the camera is turned away.
argus.option.headFollows.tooltip: In third person, your head turns toward where the camera is looking. Only you see it.
